The project owner ran scripts/crop_enmap_scene.py locally instead, producing this 264,247-byte, 224-band, AOI+150m-buffer window (same crop definition used for the 2022-09-08 scene, verified pixel-grid-identical -- see docs/WATER_MASK.md section 8). Full per-file provenance for the ORIGINAL uncropped scene is in data/metadata/enmap_20240424_DT0000070441_006_provenance.json; this record covers the crop and the water-mask result derived from it.

algorithm.name: water_mask (inland, band-group broadband + short/long index) -- SAME parameters as the 2022-09-08 run, not re-tuned
algorithm.description: Identical function and parameters as data/water_mask/provenance.json (the 2022-09-08 record) -- run against this scene specifically to test whether the same thresholds generalize across dates. See pipeline/water_mask.py and docs/WATER_MASK.md.
algorithm.units_out: boolean mask, True = candidate water/wet-core pixel
assumptions: Same three assumptions as the 2022-09-08 provenance record (band ordering, 1/10000 reflectance scale, bad-band handling).
limitations: Same limitations as the 2022-09-08 record, PLUS the key finding of this run: the two-criterion mask does NOT select the same physical location the 2022-09-08 mask did, even though that location (rows 7-10, cols 12-16 in the shared pixel grid) is still visibly the darkest broadband patch in this scene too (brightness as low as 0.035-0.05). Its short_long_index is strongly NEGATIVE here (-0.15 to -0.33), the opposite sign from the 2022-09-08 wet core -- so it fails the second criterion and is excluded. The 4 pixels this run DID select (rows 12-13, cols 23-24) were among the BRIGHTEST, driest pixels in the 2022-09-08 scene (0.30-0.36 reflectance then). Full detail in docs/WATER_MASK.md section 9 -- this is reported as a finding, not resolved or re-tuned here.

comparison_to_2022_09_08.spatial_overlap_of_selected_pixels: none -- zero shared pixel locations between the two dates' final masks
comparison_to_2022_09_08.reason_not_selected: short_long_index sign flip at that location between dates (see limitations above)

status_update_2026_09_19: This record remains the accurate historical provenance for the SINGLE-DATE water_mask()/short_long_index result. For cross-date use, this criterion was found not to generalize (see algorithm.limitations above) and has been REPLACED by persistent_wet_core() -- see data/water_mask/provenance_persistent_wet_core.json and docs/WATER_MASK.md section 12. This file is not edited otherwise; the original result stands as originally recorded.
